required_manual_checks.description: Remove the obsolete absolute global events count. Capture the relevant baseline before this suite creates its temporary fixtures and compare after its operations using a discriminating measure tied to this suite. Prove that the suite appended no unexpected event; do not hardcode a current production total or infer zero writes from cleanup. Historical evidence suggests zero suite events but does not establish it for this run.

Demonstrate a mutation or adversarial control in which an injected event attributable to this suite makes the repaired event assertion fail. Do not append an event to production for the control; keep the test focused and leave the production event log unchanged.

Make the nonfixture prospect assertion account explicitly for rows whose slug is NULL. Preserve a meaningful before/after or other suite-scoped nonfixture check without relying on SQL NOT LIKE to include NULL or on a hardcoded current production count.

Preserve the existing applogin-* temporary fixture creation, authorization assertions, afterAll cleanup, and cleanup verification. Allow no production mutation beyond that existing fixture lifecycle; do not change runtime, authorization/session code, migrations, gate runner, Coordinator, vault data, Sales, or 2A.2d.

Run only production-app-login.test.ts in the controlled proof environment. Report exact passed, failed, and skipped counts, fixture creation and cleanup evidence, the event-delta and adversarial-control results, a read-only post-run cleanup verification, and a clean git status. Do not run the full production DB gate unless this task contract explicitly requires it or claim a full gate receipt from a focused run.

Change only apps/os/tests/db/production-app-login.test.ts. Base the repair on accepted DB-PROOF-001 and the promoted DB-PARITY-001 baseline. Do not start DB-ISOLATION-001. Report any remaining limitation and freeze/publish the exact candidate for Claude review through Coordinator; do not deploy.
